title: 1. Creating a user account
bodyHtml:
1. How to create a user account

To use the BYOR service, you will need to have a user account. To create an account for the service, please fill out this form.

2. User privileges

There are two levels of users in the service: authenticated users and registered users.

Authenticated users are allowed to use up to 20MB of disk space to upload files (limited to 8MB per file), and are expected to build research pages by themselves.

Registered users have flexible disk space limits. User upload is limited to 8MB per file, but our service team can upload larger files for the users if necessary. We can help registered users with tasks as simple as configuring pages or as challenging as adding visualizers, formatting datasets, and creating data points.
